map.因为邮箱的完整语法（RFC 5322）极其复杂，包含引号、注释与嵌套结构，用单个: Because the full email syntax (RFC 5322) is extremely complex, with quotes, comments, and nested structures, precise matching with a single regex is nearly impossible. In practice only loose validation is done (e.g. "contains @ and a dot after @"); true verification requires sending a confirmation email. This is also why strict validation mistakenly rejects legitimate users.
